observations: Photos show a set of used tyres stacked (appears to be 4 tyres).
Tread blocks are visible and look relatively deep; tyres appear to be winter/all-season style with dense sipes/tread pattern.
No clear sidewall damage, cuts, or obvious bulges are visible in these angles.
Brand/model and tyre size are not readable in the provided photos.
No wheel/rim details are clearly shown; photos mainly show tyres.

claims.evidence: Photos show tyres only; no readable origin/branding or wheel details to confirm Belgium or wheels.
Tread depth is not measurable from photos; no tread-depth gauge reading or tyre size/markings visible.
Photos do not show the full sidewalls and inner areas; cannot confirm absence of repairs or internal bulges.
No DOT date codes or vehicle/receipt evidence visible in the photos.

risks.risk: Tyre size/model not readable; wrong size would make the set unusable or reduce value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the tyre sidewall showing the full size (e.g., 205/55R16) and brand/model text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown-size used tyres (worst-case fit risk), not premium.

risks.risk: Tread depth claim (90%) may be overstated; photos can’t confirm exact remaining mm.
risks.proof: Photo of tread depth measurement with a gauge (mm) at 3–4 points per tyre, or a clear DOT + wear indicators close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-90%-tread (worst-case: moderate wear), not near-new.

risks.risk: Repairs/patches or internal damage may exist but aren’t visible from these angles.
risks.proof: Photos of each tyre’s inner sidewall and tread surface under light, plus a close-up of any repair marks; ideally a quick spin/balance check report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres with unknown repair history (worst-case: treat as potentially repaired/used hard).

risks.risk: Age risk: tyres could be older than claimed; DOT date codes not shown.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of DOT code on each tyre (week/year).
risks.if_unproven: Price as older used tyres (worst-case: age reduces value).

risks.risk: “Tyres and wheels” may be misleading—wheels/rims may not be included or may be different from what’s shown.
risks.proof: Photos showing the wheels/rims clearly (front/back) and matching tyre/wheel set count.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres only (worst-case: no wheels included).

proof_requests: Clear sidewall close-ups for each tyre showing brand/model, full size, and DOT date code (week/year).
Tread depth measurements in mm at multiple points per tyre (or photos showing wear indicators).
Photos of inner sidewalls and any repair areas (tread + both sidewalls).
Confirm whether wheels/rims are included: show full wheel photos and confirm tyre count matches wheel count.
response.reason: The photos show used tyres with decent-looking tread, but the tyre size/brand/model and DOT age codes are not readable, and the seller’s key claims (90% tread, no repairs, 2023 origin, and Belgium wheels) can’t be verified remotely. Without those, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
